title: chat-server: supportedBodyTypes rule
description: Draft L245 now: supportedBodyTypes = types a Message bodyType can take; server MUST accept every listed type on Message/set create except types a companion spec reserves for server-created Messages; MUST include text/plain unless the server accepts only E2EE body types. Check SUPPORTED_BODY_TYPES/abf6969a validation, capability docs, testjig supportedBodyTypes, and whether a reserved-type hook is needed for application/mimi-fanout (mimid).

Gates green.
